fields.statement: At ae8ad5d3: go test -trimpath ./internal/docs/... passes; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(docs-reference-cli|describe-golden)$' -count=1 passes. The docs-reference-cli testscript runs rhiza docs --out into $WORK, checks the '## rhiza request' section lists --kind and --milestone with a pattern whose lines may not start with '#', so it cannot run into a later section, checks the exit codes, checks a fixture whose request section lacks --milestone fails, and checks a second run is byte-identical. I built the binary, ran rhiza docs --out into a scratch dir, and read the request section: usage line, arguments, flags with descriptions, --json output fields; the doc has 114 command sections and a shared Exit codes section. Mutation check for the attempt-2 finding: I deleted the request section's --milestone line from the generated cli.md and ran the testscript's --milestone regexp (Go regexp, with (?m)) on it: no match (it matches the unedited file), and the --kind regexp still matches. So the finding is fixed.
